This iconic scene will never feel the same again. Rest in peace, RJ Mitte (1992–2026). 🤍

RJ Mitte has died at 34, his representatives confirmed on October 12. The Breaking Bad actor passed away in Brownsville, Texas.

The heart, conscience, and grounding soul of the White family. As Walter White Jr., RJ brought unmatched authenticity to television, turning a defining role into a monumental step forward for disability representation and awareness on screen.

From the tense family dinners that kept us on the edge of our seats to the quiet moments of heartbreak, his presence defined a generation of prestige television. Far beyond Albuquerque, he was a tireless advocate and a powerful voice for inclusion.

Thank you for everything, RJ. You will be deeply missed. 🕊️
